what_this_is: A rehearsal of the GATE 1 analysis against the events the app posted during a run on the Vega Virtual Device. It measures what the app believed about media time, not what the screen showed.
what_this_is_not: GATE 1. That is 50 trials filmed at 240 fps on a real Fire TV stick, which is the only way to see what the screen did. The virtual device's screen cannot be recorded on this machine: macOS exposes no capture device without the Screen Recording permission, and the window is not captured anyway because the app draws on a GPU layer that both screen grabs and QEMU's screendump miss.
